# PROMPTS.md — world1 portal research (byte-exact where saved)
Research-only. Work under `/workspace/fixion-content/world1/`. Not shipped to Fixion Main.
All model calls tagged `world1/...` in `round3/logs/spend.jsonl`.
Prompt store: `round3/prompts/world1/` (319 files). Local copies of induction compares: `world1/prompts/`.

## Flag legend
- **NEW** — authored for this portal research (not in round3 recipe before).
- **REUSED** — round3 free/cast/placeable/setmap/place/gate stack, with portal continuity lines spliced in.
- **FORCED** — destination title / arrival / world lines injected after free gen to stop parent cloning.

### NEW: START_META portal seeds (expand.py)

### NEW / FORCED: child continuity lines (expand.child_opening)

After free title/bios/tale, child openings are rebuilt so the destination world is explicit and parent scene is not cloned. Key forced phrases include destination title as map title, `Came from: <parent>`, arrival via portal how/feature, and a one-line world blurb for the dest.

CHARACTERS

FIGGS (Man, 52) — Owner and bartender of Figgs & Potts. Friendly to regulars. Loves draft beer but keeps wine, whiskey, etc. for anything a customer might want.

NUAZ (Woman, late 20s) — Regular at Figgs & Potts. Sits with her boots on the table, plays on a tablet. Works as a freelance “resolver” (mercenary/hacker/fixer). Sarcastic and crass. She has a small floating drone companion named “Buzz.”

YARA (Woman, late 20s) — Nuaz’s childhood friend. Works a corporate job at a high-rise in the city center. Dresses professionally. Polished, anxious, secretly unhappy. She visits the bar occasionally to see Nuaz.

VELL (Man, early 30s) — Nuaz’s ex-boyfriend. A "corporate fixer" / high-end mercenary. Sleek, expensive cybernetics. Charming but ruthless. He and Nuaz had a bad breakup involving a job gone wrong. He shows up at the bar to "reconnect" or hire her.

Episode 1 — The Not-Yet World

△ Creation myth. The gods are young.
△ At a cliffside at the edge of the everything, a group of young gods sit around a fire.

CHARACTERS

VHUL (God, Ageless) — The Eldest. The First to wake. He did not make the fire; he *is* the fire. He speaks in certainties. He holds the Shape of Things. He is tired of the dark.

SOLA (Goddess, Ageless) — The Second. She did not wake; she was *sung* awake by Vhul. She holds the Light of Things. She is bright, sharp, and cruel in her kindness. She wants the dark to end.

MOIRA (God, Ageless) — The Third. He woke to the sound of Vhul and Sola arguing. He holds the *End* of Things. He is quiet, patient, and already bored. He knows how the story finishes.

KIRA (God, Ageless) — The Fourth. She woke because she was curious. She holds the *Chance* of Things. She is chaotic, loud, and delighted. She wants the story to *not* finish.

THE DRUDGE (Entity, Ageless) — Not a god. The cleanup crew. Sweeps ash. Mops starlight. Mutters. Has seen ten thousand universes born and die. Just wants overtime pay.

 A Crypt Beneath The Gravestone

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ This place is a crypt beneath the gravestone.
△ The adventurer has just arrived from Field of Morrows via the gravestone.
△ The adventurer is a middle-aged salaryman reincarnated as a skeleton. He is confused.

CHARACTERS

THE ADVENTURER (Man, 40s soul / Ageless body) — Former middle-management salaryman. Died of overwork (karoshi). Reincarnated as a sentient skeleton with [Appraisal] and [Inventory] skills. Retains his corporate mindset: risk-averse, process-oriented, politely terrified. Speaks in internal monologue (polite Japanese corporate keigo) and external rattling. Just wants a stable "job" and to not be exorcised.

ZANKARIS (Ghost, Ancient) — The ghost bound to the sword atop the gravestone. Former Hero King. Bored, cynical, sarcastic. Acts as unwilling tutorial NPC. Wants the Adventurer to pull the sword so he can finally move on / possess a body / see the sun.

THE DRUDGE (Entity, Ageless) — The same cleanup entity from the Creation Myth. Sweeps bone dust. Mops ectoplasm. Mutters about "another one." Unionized across realities. Offers cryptic hints disguised as complaints.

## Prompts that may need human approval before reuse
- **BIBLE_SYS** and **EXTRA_EX / EXTRA_EXITS** (new authored prose).
- **EX_EXITS** few-shot exit lines for Morrows and Figgs & Potts.
- **START_META** hand portal seeds (dest names + kinds).

<!-- V2_START -->

## Quality pass v2 (2026-10-30): NEW / CHANGED prompt text, awaiting Josh's approval

Flags: **[NEW]** = text written in this pass and sent to a model. **[CHANGED]** = v1 text or document shape altered. **[UNCHANGED]** = reused as-is (listed so the flow reads end to end). Everything below is quoted byte-exact from the code that sends it. Full prompt files for one map of each call type follow; the appendix at the end of this file holds every v2 prompt in full.

### Flow per portal child (lib/expand_v2.py)

1. heading: Nemotron completes the next scene heading of an episode document that holds the trail (start scene, parent scene for depth 2), the player line (refresh only) and the step through the portal. Up to 7 samples; headings already on the trail, in the few-shot, or naming only the portal are dropped; **Jev picks** among the rest. **[NEW] document shape**
2. tale: Nemotron CONTINUES the same episode document (scene N body after the heading). **[CHANGED]** (v1 and early v2: a fresh "Episode 1" tale after the bios)
3. bios: Nemotron bios with the heading as title, the trail + the scene's first beats as △ lines, and canon bios of party members pre-filled under CHARACTERS (v1 used the forced title and an instruction bracket). **[CHANGED]**
4. people-only cast filter (Jev, CAST_Q), room-key induce2 module, placeable (Jev, PQ; cap 7 -> 11), setmap classify/alias/place (Jev). **[UNCHANGED text]**
5. world-scoped gate: gates.mismatch's Jev place question **[UNCHANGED]** + code-side copy check scoped to worlds **[CHANGED code, no prompt text]**.

### [NEW] Portal step △ templates (`BEAT`, filled with the player name and the portal feature)

````text
{
 "door": "{who} opens {f} and steps through.",
 "descent": "{who} finds a way down at {f} and climbs down into what lies below.",
 "climb": "{who} climbs out by {f} and up.",
 "edge": "{who} leaves by {f} and keeps going."
}
````

### [NEW] Heading slug + IE rule

Trail scenes are written `N.  INT.|EXT.  PLACE` (v2 run 1 used the pool's `N.  TITLE  INT.  PLACE`; the episode title equals the start place, so the model repeated it). The document ends with `N.  INT. ` or `N.  EXT. ` (descent = INT., climb/edge = EXT., door into = INT., other doors flip the previous scene). Scene block template (code):

````text
f"{i}.  {sc['ie']}  {sc['place_head']}\n\nCHARACTERS: {', '.join(sc['cast']) or 'none'}\n\n"
+ ''.join(f"△ {b.rstrip('.')}.\n" for b in sc['beats'] if b)
````

### [NEW] Jev heading pick (`JEV_PICK`, type choice over the candidate headings)

````text
The player was in {prev}. {beat} Earlier player line: {action}. Which of these scene headings names the most plausible and specific NEW place for them to arrive in next, through that exact way (a stair down leads somewhere below, a door leads in or out, a climb leads up, an edge leads further on), and fits the player line if there is one?
````

### [NEW] Jev is-a-place check per candidate heading (`JEV_PLACE`, noul, keep >= 0.5)

````text
Does the scene heading "{t}" name a place someone could stand in (a room, building, street, cave, forest, rooftop...)? Answer no if it names only a time, weather, a person, an event or a feeling.
````

### [NEW] Blind A/B judge rubric (`judge_ab_v2.SYSTEM`; the OpenRouter run was blocked by the $10 key guard, so the same rubric was given verbatim to 4 Opus 5.5 subagents, see below)

````text
You compare two candidate maps for the same spot in a top-down narrative game. The player is in one map and walks through a portal (a door, a stair down, a ladder up, or off an edge); the candidate maps are what could be on the other side. Each map is drawn in the game's pixel style, 15x16 tiles; letters are characters, @ is the player. Each comes with its own title and SET (place label and props the writer asked for).

Pick the better map on each criterion:
- legible: you can tell what the place is at a glance; it is furnished and lit well enough to read, not a mostly empty or dark box.
- matches: the drawing shows the place its own title and set describe.
- continuity: it is a believable, NEW place to reach from the parent map through that portal (not a copy or a fold-back of the parent; right for the kind of portal).
- overall: which would you rather ship as the place behind that portal.

Reply with JSON only: {"legible": "1"|"2"|"tie", "matches": "1"|"2"|"tie", "continuity": "1"|"2"|"tie", "overall": "1"|"2", "why": "<= 25 words"}
````

User turn: `Parent map: {parent}. Portal: {kind} via {feature}.` then for Map 1 and Map 2: `\nMap {L}. Title: {title}. SET: {set_line}` + the render crop, then `\nJSON only.`

### [NEW] Subagent judge prompts (Opus 5.5 Claude Code subagents; byte-exact)

pass1a shown; pass1b / pass2a / pass2b are identical except the directory name in the first sentence (`/tmp/abjudge/pass1b/` etc.). The packets each agent read (PAIRS.txt + images) follow in full.

````text
You are a blind judge for a game-content research study. Only read files inside /tmp/abjudge/pass1a/ (do not open any other path, do not search the filesystem, do not run scripts). Use the Read tool to view PAIRS.txt and every image it names (pairNN_map1.png and pairNN_map2.png). Judge each pair independently using exactly this rubric:

"""You compare two candidate maps for the same spot in a top-down narrative game. The player is in one map and walks through a portal (a door, a stair down, a ladder up, or off an edge); the candidate maps are what could be on the other side. Each map is drawn in the game's pixel style, 15x16 tiles; letters are characters, @ is the player. Each comes with its own title and SET (place label and props the writer asked for).

Pick the better map on each criterion:
- legible: you can tell what the place is at a glance; it is furnished and lit well enough to read, not a mostly empty or dark box.
- matches: the drawing shows the place its own title and set describe.
- continuity: it is a believable, NEW place to reach from the parent map through that portal (not a copy or a fold-back of the parent; right for the kind of portal).
- overall: which would you rather ship as the place behind that portal."""

Values: "1", "2" or "tie" for legible/matches/continuity; "1" or "2" for overall. Be decisive and judge only what you see and read in the packet.

Final answer: ONLY a JSON array, one object per pair in order, e.g.
[{"pair": 1, "legible": "2", "matches": "1", "continuity": "2", "overall": "2", "why": "<= 25 words"}, ...]
````

Map 2 (pair04_map2.png). Title: 직원 통로 / 백룸. SET: A backroom behind the boutique: the staff lockers, the stock shelves, the break table, the CCTV monitor, the staff bathroom, the service door to the mall corridor, the argument door to the sales floor, the time clock, the door back

PAIR 05
Parent map: Field of Morrows (hand-authored start). Portal: descent via the gravestone.
Map 1 (pair05_map1.png). Title: The Catacombs. SET: Ancient tunnels, dust-choked, pressure-heavy: the descent shaft, the gravestone lid, the first landing, the forgotten niches, the stairs up
Map 2 (pair05_map2.png). Title: A Crypt Beneath The Gravestone. SET: A damp stone room: the stone coffin, the stairs up, the gravestone, the hero's sword (above, the Drudge's cart, the bone pile, the rats' nest

PAIR 06
Parent map: the place reached from Field of Morrows via a gap in the old stone wall. Portal: a further way on from there (going deeper).
Map 1 (pair06_map1.png). Title: A Deeper Chamber. SET: A deeper chamber beneath the Field of Morrows: the stair, the glowing crystal veins, the stone dais, the buried desk, the floating grimoire, the Sage's chair, a pile of empty mana potion vials
Map 2 (pair06_map2.png). Title: Dungeon. SET: An ancient, alien, layered, and undeniable dungeon: the cellar hole, the damp stairs, the threshold, the first hall, the fungus gardens, the echoing shaft, the false door, the black water, the stairs up

Map 2 (pair07_map2.png). Title: The village road below the field. SET: A dirt road winding from the Field of Morrows toward the village of Oakhaven: the dirt road, the village gates, the Field of Morrows, wildflowers, the sword at Ren's hip, Korvin's daggers, Mira's staff

Parent map: 루이 뉘똥 샾 (hand-authored start). Portal: door via 유리문.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: High fantasy isekai.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Field of Morrows

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS — a knight of the Church of Morning Star, 21: once the chosen hero, her legend ended in failure; scarred armor, notched sword; she speaks little

VELLICHOR — Zankaris's unicorn: ancient, sentient and sarcastic; he never speaks, not even by telepathy

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  EXT.  FIELD OF MORROWS

CHARACTERS: Zankaris, Vellichor

△ the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ Zankaris, a knight of the Church of Morning Star, 21: once the chosen hero, her legend ended in failure; scarred armor, notched sword; she speaks little, in front of the gravestone.
△ Vellichor, Zankaris's unicorn: ancient, sentient and sarcastic; he never speaks, not even by telepathy, beside Zankaris.
△ The adventurer pours lamp oil into the crack under the gravestone and drops a lit match after it.
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.

2.  INT.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

△ Space opera.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Carries a RUNE-CANNON on her back — a heavy, modified arcane artillery piece that folds into a blocky rectangle. It hums with suppressed violence. She's tired. She's broke. She has a familiar tucked in her jacket pocket.

POTTS (Man, late 20s) — Figgs' partner. The face, the talker, the planner. Currently inside working the room. He's charming, sharp, and deeply in debt to the wrong people. He trusts Figgs with his life. He shouldn't.

THE FAMILIAR — "SCRAP" (Tiny, mechanical, resembles a crab made of circuit boards and wire) — Figgs' familiar. Sarcastic, loyal, runs on mana batteries Figgs can't afford. It clicks and chirps. It judges her choices.

THE BAR — FIGGS & POTTS (The establishment) — A suburban dive for off-duty enforcers, minor mages, and people who don't ask questions. Neon sign flickers: "FIGGS & POTTS — DRINKS • SPELLS • NO QUESTIONS." The name is a joke Potts made. Figgs hated it. It stuck.

A FIGURE IN THE ALLEY — ??? — Waiting. Patient. Smoking something that smells like ozone and old blood.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ The station hums with generator noise. Rain hammers the roof. The Drip echoes from somewhere deep in the walls.
△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

CHARACTERS: Merelai, Halkric

△ Merelai sits at the window. The star fills the view.
△ Halkric walks up. She has a datapad. She stops a few meters back.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

CHARACTERS

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

AREA 1. OBSERVATION DECK
A viewing deck on the space station "The Ledge.

△ Now: EXT.  BACK ALLEY.
△ Another adventurer is there.

CHARACTERS

THE BUTCHER (Man, 40s) — Real name: KORR. A hulking wall of a man. Cybernetics grafted crudely onto flesh — a hydraulic arm, a jaw replacement that clicks when he chews. He wears a stained butcher’s apron over tactical armor. He’s not a butcher of meat. He “processes” problems for the local syndicate. He’s tired. He wants to finish this job and drink until the neon blurs.

THE SORCERER (Non-binary, 30s) — Name: VEX. Lean, sharp, covered in shifting geometric tattoos that pulse with mana-circuitry. One eye is a high-end optical implant; the other is natural, milky with cataract — a deliberate choice, a sacrifice for power. They wear a long coat lined with spell-cartridges. They’re here to collect a debt the Butcher owes. Not money. A favor.

△ The Butcher leans against the dumpster, smoking a synth-cig.
△ The Sorcerer steps out of the bar’s back door. The bass thumps muffled behind them.

△ They know each other. Old crew. Bad blood. Unfinished business.
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  BACK ALLEY  EXT.  BACK ALLEY — NIGHT

CHARACTERS: The Butcher (Korr), The Sorcerer (Vex)

△ Neon reflects in puddles. Steam hisses from a grate. The bar’s bass vibrates the dumpster.
△ Korr doesn't look up. The cherry of his synth-cig pulses.
△ Vex stops three meters out. Their tattoos shift — slow, deliberate hexes idling in standby.

AREA 1.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ The station hums with generator noise. Rain hammers the roof. The Drip echoes from somewhere deep in the walls.
△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

CHARACTERS

FIGGS (Woman, 30s) — Half-elf, half-orc barkeep. Runs the place with her wife Potts. Sharp tongue, sharper ears. She polishes a glass that’s already clean. She’s seen every type of adventurer crawl through her door. Most don’t come back.

POTTS (Woman, 30s) — Human. Figgs’s wife. Cook. Quiet, immovable. She moves between kitchen and floor like a ghost. Her food heals minor wounds. Her silence heals major ones.

THE PATRON — VEX (Nonbinary, 20s) — Tiefling. Horns chipped. Cybernetic left arm, scratched to hell. They nurse a drink that glows faintly blue. They just came up from the Undercity. They’re bleeding internally. They don’t want help. They want a drink.

△ The manhole cover shifts. Steam curls up.

A single beat passes.

The manhole cover *clangs* back into place — sealed from *below*.

△ Figgs doesn't look up from her glass.
△ Potts appears from the kitchen, drying her hands on a towel. She clocks the manhole. Clocks Vex. Says nothing.
△ Vex’s cybernetic arm spasms. Blue liquid sloshes. They don’t flinch.

FIGGS
(quiet, to the room)
Door’s locked. Wards are hot. Whatever’s chasing you didn’t fit the ladder.

VEX
(voice like gravel in a synthesizer)
Didn’t say I was running.

FIGGS
Didn’t say you weren’t.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system

△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Swamp country.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ The station hums with generator noise. Rain hammers the roof. The Drip echoes from somewhere deep in the walls.
△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

CHARACTERS: Merelai, Halkric

△ Merelai sits at the window. The star fills the view.
△ Halkric walks up. She has a datapad. She stops a few meters back.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

# api=tinker model=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 tag=world1/v2/bar/bar_street/a2/free/bios

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ The station hums with generator noise. Rain hammers the roof. The Drip echoes from somewhere deep in the walls.
△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

CHARACTERS: Merelai, Halkric

△ Merelai sits at the window. The star fills the view.
△ Halkric walks up. She has a datapad. She stops a few meters back.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — Below

△ Cyberpunk fantasy.
△ Before this: A suburban street in Gottél.
△ The adventurer finds a way down at into the alleyway and climbs down into what lies below.
△ Now: INT.  BELOW.
△ Yara and Vell descend into the undercity.
△ Magical sigils pulse on the walls. The air hums with latent mana. Ancient tech fused with modern grime.

CHARACTERS

YARA — Nuaz's childhood friend, a polished corporate worker

VELL — Nuaz's ex, a sleek corporate fixer

△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.

She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

The bar sits in a crawlspace beneath Gottél’s suburban grid. Low ceiling. Exposed pipework. Neon signs reflected in spilled beer. A place for people who don’t want to be found by the same people who know exactly where they are.

FIGGS (50s, human, augmented liver, zero patience) polishes a glass with a rag that has seen generations. Her left eye is a high-end ocular — military surplus, recalibrated for pour-precision and threat assessment. She doesn’t blink often.

POTTS (robot, chassis: repurposed industrial loader, screen-face cycling through ASCII expressions) floats a tray of synth-nuts to Table 3. Current face: `[ :) ]`. A regular grunts thanks without looking up.

NUAZ (30s, human, chrome fingers on left hand, right eye a dull ceramic prosthetic) sits in the corner booth. Boots on table. Coat draped over the back. Her drone, BUZZ (palm-sized, matte black, silent rotors), hovers at her shoulder, running passive scans. `[SCAN: CLEAN]` scrolls across Nuaz’s retinal HUD.

The door chimes. A real bell. Analog. Figgs installed it herself.

NYX (Woman, early 30s) — Half-elf. Fixer / Information Broker. Operates out of a converted maintenance tunnel beneath Gottél. Neon-dreads, subdermal circuitry tattoos that pulse with her mood. She wants a favor in return — something dangerous. She’s not human enough for the corps, not elven enough for the courts. She survives in the cracks.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — 지하실

△ Modern Korean apartment, late night.

△ Now: INT.  지하실.
△ Not just a basement — a massive, layered space. Old things, strange things, living things.

CHARACTERS

GWANG-SU (Man, 36) — Building manager (관리소장). Divorced. Insomniac. Takes the night shift because the dark doesn't ask questions. Knows every pipe, every wire, every resident's rhythm. Carries a master key ring that weighs like a gun. Found the hatch behind the elevator maintenance panel three nights ago. Has been climbing down every night since. Looking for something he lost. Or something that called him.

THE CUSTODIAN (Entity, ???) — Not human. Not ghost. The basement's immune system. Tall, too many joints. Wears the faces of things the building has swallowed: a lost cat, a dead tenant's mother, a child's toy rabbit. Speaks in the building's sounds: creaking pipes, elevator chimes, muffled arguments through walls. It maintains the basement. It remembers everything. It is bored.

MIN-JI (Woman, 28) — Resident 402. Graphic designer. Works nights. Hears things through her floor vent. Started leaving offerings: coffee, cigarettes, a USB drive with rendered footage of "clean spaces." She doesn't believe in ghosts. She believes in *systems*. She thinks the basement is a server farm. Or a bunker. Or a collective unconscious made manifest. She's right about one of them.

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.

△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — 복도

△ Modern Korean apartment, late night.

△ Now: EXT.  복도.
△ 광수 pauses on the threshold, half in, half out.

CHARACTERS

광수  (Man, 29) — Project manager at a mid-sized construction firm. Currently on leave (burnout, undisclosed). Lives alone in this apartment for three years. Meticulous, quiet, the type who aligns his shoes perfectly. Hasn't slept properly in weeks. His therapist suggested "small exposures." Tonight's exposure: stand in the hallway for five minutes.

은우  (Man, 28) — 광수's neighbor, Unit 302. Night shift nurse at a university hospital. Gentle, observant, runs on coffee and dry humor. Often sees 광수's light on at 3 AM. Has left small offerings at his door: a packaged sandwich, a cold drink, a note saying "hard night?" Never knocks. Never expects thanks.

주민 (Woman, 50s) — The building's representative (통장). Sharp-eyed, rules-oriented, but not unkind. Patrols the hallway nightly. Knows everyone's business, remembers everyone's trash schedule. She's the one who complained about 광수's "suspicious late-night comings and goings" (he took out recycling at 2 AM twice).

택배기사 (Man, 40s) — Regular delivery driver for this building. Knows the rhythm of each unit. Calls 광수 "PM-nim" because of the hard hat he saw once. Has a daughter 광수's age.

의문의 발소리 — Footsteps from Unit 304 (vacant for six months). Light, irregular. Sometimes they stop at 광수's door. Sometimes they don't exist at all.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.
