Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

1.  THE DRIP  NIGHT  INT. RESEARCH STATION

CHARACTERS: Mallow, Nim, Tek

△ The station hums with generator noise. Rain hammers the roof. The Drip echoes from somewhere deep in the walls.
△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

A stone bridge over a black canal.
Features: the bridge railing, a rusted winch, the canal ladder, a watch lamp, the toll booth.

Exits: east → the lower docks (down the canal ladder); west → the mill yard (across the bridge); north → a toll house loft (up the booth stair)

AREA 1. THE NIGHT LAUNDROMAT
A narrow coin laundromat open all night.
Features: the row of washers, the folding table, a plastic chair, the change machine, the back door.
Occupants: Odile (at the folding table).
Exits: out → the wet street (through the front door); back → a loading yard (through the back door); up → the landlord's flat (the stair behind the dryers)

The street outside the boutique.
Features: the glass façade, the valet podium, the planter box, the curb, the traffic mirror, the crosswalk signal, the coffee cart, the door back.
Occupants: none.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — Street

△ Modern Seoul. Luxury retail.

△ 주만 opens through the 별채 door and steps through, toward the 별채.
△ Now: EXT.  STREET.
△ A quiet residential street near the house.
△ 주만 walks.

CHARACTERS

JUMAN 주만 (Woman, 46) — Former lady of a chaebol household. Twenty years managing the main house, the staff, the rituals, the silence. Now divorced, stripped of the title, living in the 별채 (detached annex) on the same grounds. She walks the neighborhood at dawn because the main house wakes at 7 AM sharp and she is no longer part of that rhythm. She wears clothes that cost more than the cars passing her, but she carries a canvas tote from a bakery that closed three years ago. Her hands remember how to direct a household of thirty. Her heart remembers how to be invisible.

MINJAE 민재 (Man, 28) — Juman’s only child. Works at the family conglomerate’s strategic planning division. The golden successor. He visits the 별채 every Sunday at 3 PM with takeout from a Michelin place. He calls her "Mother" in Korean, "Mom" in English when he’s drunk. He thinks he’s negotiating a merger; she thinks he’s visiting his mom. He drives a Genesis G90. He has never pumped his own gas.

HYEJIN 혜진 (Woman, 44) — Juman’s childhood friend. Runs a failing hanbok modernization label in Seongsu-dong. Calls Juman "Unnie" when she needs a favor, "Juman-ah" when she’s drunk. She knows every crack in Juman’s armor. She brings soju to the 별채 on Tuesdays. She drives a dented Kia Morning. She has pumped her own gas a thousand times.
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1. EXT.  STREET

CHARACTERS: 주만, 용희

△ A quiet residential street near the house.
△ 주만 walks.
△ 용희 follows at a distance, hood up.

△ 민서 (Woman, 32) — Executive Director, Brand Strategy. His daughter. Standing. She placed the report there. She waits.

CHARACTERS

JUMAN 주만 (Man, 55) — Chairman, HANA Group luxury retail division. Built the empire from a single duty-free counter in the 90s. Speaks in silence and pauses. Decides with a glance. He wears a Patek Philippe he never checks. He knows the price of every stitch in every window display on Cheongdam-ro. He is dying — slowly, quietly, amyloidosis — and no one knows except his doctor. He intends to die before the company does.

MINSEO 민서 (Woman, 32) — Executive Director, Brand Strategy. Juman’s only child. Spent a decade in Paris and New York buying for multi-brand boutiques. Came back two years ago "to help." She has not been helped. She speaks in decks and KPIs; he speaks in texture and light. She wants to digitize, globalize, franchise. He wants to burn the spreadsheet. She loves him in a language he doesn't recognize. He loves her in a language she stopped listening for.

JIHOON 지훈 (Man, 29) — Minseo’s cousin by marriage (her aunt’s stepson). "Creative Director" on paper. Actually: the family’s designated failure, kept close to be managed. Beautiful, bored, deeply cynical. He sketches window displays no one will build. He knows Juman is dying. He knows Minseo doesn’t.

Episode 1 — The Drip

△ Swamp country.
△ A small research station in the wetlands.
△ A trio of workers live here: Mallow, Mallow’s son, and Mallow’s employee.

CHARACTERS

MALLOW (Woman, 50s) — The station lead. Practical, weathered, runs a tight ship. She knows the swamp better than the back of her hand. She’s seen too many researchers come and go. She drinks swamp-tea and smokes hand-rolled cigarettes.

MALLOW’S SON — NIM (Man, early 20s) — Born and raised in the swamp. Lanky, quiet, observant. He doesn’t speak much. He maintains the station’s systems — generators, water filtration, comms. He knows every sound of the wetland. He’s never left.

MALLOW’S EMPLOYEE — TEK (Woman, late 20s) — An outsider. Hired for her expertise in anomalous flora. She’s sharp, skeptical, and writes everything down in a waterproof notebook. She’s here for the grant money, but the swamp is getting under her skin. She and Nim have a quiet, unspoken rapport.

△ Mallow sits at the main table, cleaning a shotgun. Tek writes in her notebook. Nim checks the generator readouts.
△ A transmission crackles over the radio. Static, then a voice.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — Miroku & Miroku

△ Modern Japan, on the shinkansen.
△ Miroku (Woman, early 20s) — Sitting in a reserved seat, working on a laptop. She is a junior software engineer. Tired but focused. She has a habit of talking to herself quietly.
△ Miroku (Man, early 20s) — Sitting next to her by coincidence. Same surname, same given name, same kanji. He is a freelance illustrator. Sketching on a tablet. Calm, observant. He notices the coincidence immediately.

CHARACTERS

MIROKU (Woman, early 20s) — Junior software engineer. Commutes weekly between Tokyo and Osaka for a project. Lives on convenience store onigiri and strong coffee. Anxious, over-prepares for everything, talks to herself to debug her own brain. "Miroku" (弥勒) — a name heavy with future Buddha connotations; she feels the weight of it.

MIROKU (Man, early 20s) — Freelance illustrator. Traveling to Osaka for a doujin event. Goes with the flow, forgets to eat, draws constantly. His "Miroku" (弥勒) is just a name his parents liked the sound of. He finds the coincidence hilarious.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  SHINKANSEN  DAY  INT.

CHARACTERS: Miroku (F), Miroku (M)

△ The train hums along. Miroku (F) types. Miroku (M) sketches.
△ Miroku (M) glances at her screen — sees her name on a commit message. Then at her reservation ticket on the table. His eyes widen fractionally.
△ He taps his own ticket against the table. A rhythm. *Tap. Tap-tap. Tap.*

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

THE GHOST / LADY ELARA VANCE (Woman, appears 20s, died 847 years ago) — *Not* his ancestor. Just a coincidence of names. A disgraced archmage who tried to lichdom herself, botched the ritual, and bound her soul to her own skeleton — which Caleb found in a ruin, mistook for "cool loot," and carried around in his pack for six months before she woke up. Sarcastic, magically knowledgeable, physically intangible. She cannot move more than 10 meters from her bones (currently in a velvet bag strapped to his pack). She judges his coffee technique. She is bored out of her mind.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

<|im_start|>system

<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Dungeon

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: A ruined high street in a high fantasy world.
△ The adventurer finds a way down at through a cellar hole and climbs down into what lies below, toward the cellar.
△ Now: INT.  DUNGEON.
△ A dungeon, beneath the cellar. The dungeon is ancient, alien, layered, and undeniable.
△ Zankaris proceeds deeper into the dungeon.

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS — a knight of the Church of Morning Star, 21: once the chosen hero, her legend ended in failure; scarred armor, notched sword; she speaks little

VELLICHOR — Zankaris's unicorn: ancient, sentient and sarcastic; he never speaks, not even by telepathy

It sees the Wayfarer’s True Name flickering — unreadable, corrupted, *wrong*.

THE CHAMBER ITSELF (Location, Sentient) — The dungeon’s "starter room." Semi-aware. Hungry for narrative momentum. It subtly reshapes its own geometry to force encounters, loot drops, and character beats. It *wants* the Wayfarer to pick up the sword. It *wants* a story. It whispers through the stone.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

### `prompts/world1/v2/morrows/morrows_crypt/free/bios/6cc5ec1d0b2e.txt`

````text
# api=tinker model=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 tag=world1/v2/morrows/morrows_crypt/free/bios
# ---- full prompt below this line ----
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Space opera.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Ledge

△ Space opera.
△ On a space station orbiting a dying star. A character named Merelai is sitting at a window, looking out at the star.
△ A woman named Halkric walks up to her.

CHARACTERS

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE LEDGE  INT.  OBSERVATION DECK

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

ZANKARIS (Man, 27) — The adventurer. Isekai'd three years ago. Not a hero — a surveyor. Formerly a GIS specialist / urban planner. He maps dungeons, calculates structural integrity, assesses resource flows. He wears practical leather, carries a theodolite, a compass, and a notebook. He has a "System" interface only he sees — but it gives him [Appraise], [Structural Analysis], [Pathfinding], not combat skills. He’s tired. He misses coffee. He’s looking for his brother, who arrived in this world ten years before him.

THE VOICE (???) — At the bottom of the crypt. Familiar. Older. Ragged. It knows his name.

THE SYSTEM — Not a character per se, but a persistent UI overlay. Dry, bureaucratic, occasionally passive-aggressive. It speaks in brackets. [QUEST UPDATED: FIND THE SOURCE OF THE ANOMALY.]

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system

<|im_end|>

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

MERELAI (Woman, 30s) — Former naval strategist, now a recluse. She watches the star die because she orchestrated the operation that killed it. She carries the weight of a billion deaths she ordered to win a war that ended three years ago. She drinks synthetic coffee. She doesn't sleep well.

HALKRIC (Woman, 40s) — Merelai's former XO. Pragmatic, grounded, the only one Merelai still answers comms from. She didn't follow Merelai into retirement; she stayed in the fleet. She's here on official business, but also because she's worried.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

△ Now: INT.  ANCIENT CRYPT.
△ The protagonist, who has arrived in this world only weeks ago, stands in the crypt beneath their brother's grave.
△ They are not alone.

CHARACTERS

THE PROTAGONIST (Any gender, late 20s) — Arrived three weeks ago. No cheat skills, no system window, no prophecy. Just a dull ache where their old life used to be and a fluency in the local language they never studied. They were a mid-level project manager in a life of spreadsheets and quiet compromises. They miss their cat. They miss hot showers. They miss the certainty that tomorrow would resemble today. They carry a borrowed sword they barely know how to hold and a grief that feels heavier than the dirt above them. They are not the Chosen One. They are the one who *found* the grave.

THE COMPANION (Non-human, ancient) — A entity bound to the crypt. Not a ghost. Not a demon. Something older. It has worn many shapes: a raven, a statue, a child, a sword. Currently: a floating orb of pale light with a voice like dry leaves skittering on pavement. It claims it was *waiting*. It refuses to say for whom. It is bored, sarcastic, and has forgotten more magic than the greatest archmage alive knows. It calls the Protagonist "Successor" — a clerical error, it insists. A typo in the binding contract. It has not corrected the paperwork in 300 years.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

<|im_start|>system

<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Dungeon beneath the Gravestone

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ The adventurer says: "Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's."
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.
△ Now: INT.  DUNGEON BENEATH THE GRAVESTONE.
△ Zankaris has entered a dungeon beneath the gravestone.
△ Vellichor follows, hooves silent on stone.

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS — a knight of the Church of Morning Star, 21: once the chosen hero, her legend ended in failure; scarred armor, notched sword; she speaks little

VELLICHOR — Zankaris's unicorn: ancient, sentient and sarcastic; he never speaks, not even by telepathy

△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's.
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).

<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

ZANKARIS (Man, 30s) — A modern soul in a fantasy body. Formerly a palliative care nurse. He died in his world saving a patient from a falling ambulance bay door. He is a "Grave Warden" — a class that shouldn't exist. Skills: [Grave Tending], [Final Mercy], [Memento Mori]. He carries a shovel that shifts weight based on the "burden" of the target. He speaks to the dead. They answer.

THE GRAVESTONE (Object/Entity) — The entry point. A slab of dark basalt with his brother's name. It hums with a faint, warm pulse. It is the only thing that feels like *home*.

THE WHISPERING MOSS (Environmental Hazard/Ally) — Bioluminescent moss covering the crypt walls. It feeds on memories. It whispers secrets in exchange for yours. It fears Zankaris’s shovel.

THE FIRST DWELLER (Entity) — Something ancient lives at the bottom of the crypt. It has been waiting for a Grave Warden. It wears the faces of everyone Zankaris has ever lost.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

Episode 1 — Below the Grave

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ The adventurer says: "Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's."
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.
△ Now: INT.  BELOW THE GRAVE.
△ A labyrinth of roots, stone, and forgotten things.
△ The adventurer's name is Zankaris.

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS (Man, late 20s) — The "Gravewalker." An isekai'd soul who woke up in this world six months ago inside a coffin, clawing his way out. He has no cheat skill, no system window, no goddess' blessing — just a modern man's mind, a gravedigger's shovel, and a cursed left eye that sees "Death Echoes" (residual trauma imprinted on matter). He wears pieced-together adventurer gear over a faded hoodie from his old world. He's looking for his brother, Kaelen, who arrived in this world *before* him. He's tired, cynical, and violently protective of the few things he cares about.

THE SHOVEL (Object/Companion) — A mundane-looking gravedigger's spade Zankaris modified: reinforced shaft, sharpened edge, runes carved into the blade by a drunken dwarf. It cannot cut living flesh — it *passes through* it like water — but it cleaves undead, curses, and "things that should not be" with terrifying ease. Zankaris talks to it. It doesn't talk back. (Mostly.)

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — Below the Grave

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ The adventurer says: "Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's."
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.
△ Now: INT.  BELOW THE GRAVE.
△ A labyrinth of roots, stone, and forgotten things.
△ The adventurer's name is Zankaris.

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS (Man, late 20s) — The "Gravewalker." An isekai'd soul who woke up in this world six months ago inside a coffin, clawing his way out. He has no cheat skill, no system window, no goddess' blessing — just a modern man's mind, a gravedigger's shovel, and a cursed left eye that sees "Death Echoes" (residual trauma imprinted on matter). He wears pieced-together adventurer gear over a faded hoodie from his old world. He's looking for his brother, Kaelen, who arrived in this world *before* him. He's tired, cynical, and violently protective of the few things he cares about.

THE SHOVEL (Object/Companion) — A mundane-looking gravedigger's spade Zankaris modified: reinforced shaft, sharpened edge, runes carved into the blade by a drunken dwarf. It cannot cut living flesh — it *passes through* it like water — but it cleaves undead, curses, and "things that should not be" with terrifying ease. Zankaris talks to it. It doesn't talk back. (Mostly.)
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  BELOW THE GRAVE  CONTINUOUS  INT.

CHARACTERS: Zankaris, The Shovel

△ Zankaris has just climbed down through the grave-shaft. Darkness, roots, the smell of old earth and something sharper — ozone? rot?
△ His cursed left eye activates involuntarily.
△ He sees something in the Death Echoes.

He is a "Grave Warden" — a class that shouldn't exist. Skills: [Grave Tending], [Final Mercy], [Memento Mori]. He carries a shovel that shifts weight based on the "burden" of the target. He speaks to the dead. They answer.

THE GRAVESTONE (Object/Entity) — The entry point. A slab of dark basalt with his brother's name. It hums with a faint, warm pulse. It is the only thing that feels like *home*.

THE WHISPERING MOSS (Environmental Hazard/Ally) — Bioluminescent moss covering the crypt walls. It feeds on memories. It whispers secrets in exchange for yours. It fears Zankaris’s shovel.

THE FIRST DWELLER (Entity) — Something ancient lives at the bottom of the crypt. It has been waiting for a Grave Warden. It wears the faces of everyone Zankaris has ever lost.
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.

CHARACTERS: Zankaris, The Whispering Moss, The Gravestone (flashback)

<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's.

# api=tinker model=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B-BF16 tag=world1/v2/morrows/morrows_crypt_after_name_s2/free/bios

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting set of characters. Script character bios (人物小传).
Genre: Desert world.
<|im_end|>

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. ZANKARIS (Man, 27 — apparent) — The Adventurer / The Isekai’d. Died in a hospital bed in another world (modern Japan). Woke up here three years ago. He carries a shovel that became a lance. He is tired. He has a sister’s ghost in his pocket watch. He came here looking for his brother’s grave. He found it. The name on the stone: **Kaito**. His brother. Who died *ten years before Zankaris did*.

Kaito's GHOST (Man, 19 — eternal) — Trapped in the pocket watch. Sarcastic, protective, fading. He remembers the hospital. He remembers Zankaris promising to follow him soon. He doesn’t understand why there’s a grave for *him* in this world. He whispers warnings. He’s running out of time.

THE CRYPT WARDEN (Entity, Ancient) — Not a monster. A function. A living spell woven into the stone. It tests those who descend. It speaks in riddles because it has forgotten how to speak plain. It guards the *Throne of the First Death*. It recognizes Zankaris’s class. It is... curious.

Episode 1 — The Rotwell

△ Desert world.
△ In the center of the Rotwell, a massive crater filled with strange, mutated life. The Rotwell is a place of danger and opportunity.
△ A small camp sits at the edge of the Rotwell.

CHARACTERS

KAEL (Man, 34) — A "Rotwalker." Someone who enters the Rotwell to harvest valuable materials: crystals, glands, exotic matter. He knows the safe paths, the tidal patterns of the mutation. He’s seen too many friends die. He drinks water like it’s whiskey. He has a mechanical left leg, damaged from a "surge" event years ago.

MIRA (Woman, 28) — Kael’s handler / quartermaster / only friend who stays topside. She runs the camp: supplies, comms, buyers, medical. She monitors Kael’s vitals and the Rotwell’s seismic/mutation readings. She’s sharp, organized, terrified of the day he doesn't come back. She has a prosthetic right eye that links to the camp’s sensor array.

OLD JORAN (Man, 60s) — The only other permanent resident. A former Rotwalker who "retired" (got too mutated to go deep). He maintains the winches, the air scrubbers, the heavy gear. He’s half-crystallized himself — skin like geode on his left side. He mutters to the Rotwell like it’s a neighbor.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  THE ROTWELL — EDGE CAMP  DAY  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kael, Mira, Old Joran

△ The camp at the edge of the Rotwell. Kael is gearing up for a descent. Mira is monitoring. Old Joran is maintaining the winch.
△ A stranger (woman, early 30s) approaches the camp from the wasteland.

AREA 1. EDGE CAMP
A camp at the crater's rim.
Features: the winch, the sensor array, the supply tent, the medical cot, the water still, Joran's workbench, the ration barrels, the comms mast.
Occupants: Kael (at the winch); Mira (at the sensor array); Old Joran (at Joran's workbench).

Episode 1 — The Long Winter

△ Prehistoric world, the last ice age.
△ A small band of humans, the "River People," travel along a frozen river.
△ They stop to make camp for the night.

CHARACTERS

KYA (Woman, 32) — The band’s lead hunter. Broad-shouldered, scarred, pragmatic. She carries a spear tipped with a mammoth ivory point. She speaks rarely, preferring hand signs. She lost her mate two winters past; she does not speak of him. She watches the treeline constantly.

TORN (Man, 28) — The band’s toolmaker and fire-keeper. Fingers stained with ochre and resin. He carries the "Fire Horn" — a hollowed bison horn holding a smoldering coal, the band’s most precious possession. He is anxious, inventive, talks to himself when he works. He fears the dark more than the cold.

MIRA (Girl, 12) — Kya’s niece. Torn’s daughter. Quick, quiet, observant. She is learning the hunt but is not yet allowed a spear. She collects small things: feathers, strange stones, beads of amber. She dreams of the "Green Land" the elders speak of in stories.

THE ELDER (Agender, 60+) — The band’s memory. Blind, wrapped in furs. Carries a staff carved with the history of the band. They do not walk; they are carried on a travois pulled by the band’s two surviving dogs. They speak in riddles and old tongues.

<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FROZEN RIVER VALLEY  DUSK  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Kya, Torn, Mira, The Elder

△ The band arrives at a sheltered bend in the frozen river. Wind howls.
△ They begin to make camp. Urgency.
△ The Elder speaks of a dream.

AREA 1. FROZEN RIVER VALLEY
A frozen river valley.
Features: the ice shelf, the cut bank, the driftwood pile, the travois, the fire pit, the windbreak stones, the treeline, the dog harnesses.
Occupants: Kya (at the treeline); Torn (at the fire pit); Mira (at the driftwood pile); The Elder (at the travois).

Episode 1 — Crypt

△ High fantasy isekai.
△ Before this: the field of morrows, an open misty meadow of old graves in a high-fantasy world.
△ Zankaris — the name on this stone isn't a stranger's. It's your brother's.
△ The adventurer finds a way down at the gravestone and climbs down into what lies below.
△ Now: INT.  CRYPT.
△ The adventurer is badly wounded.

CHARACTERS

ZANKARIS (Man, 27 — apparent) — The Adventurer / The Isekai’d. Died in a hospital bed in another world (modern Japan). Woke up here three years ago. Class: [Gravewalker] — a rare, stigmatized class that draws power from death, memory, and decay. He doesn’t use holy magic; he uses *resonance*. He can ask the dead one question each. He carries a shovel that became a lance. He is tired. He has a sister’s ghost in his pocket watch. He came here looking for his brother’s grave. He found it. The name on the stone: **Kaito**. His brother. Who died *ten years before Zankaris did*.

Kaito's GHOST (Man, 19 — eternal) — Trapped in the pocket watch. Sarcastic, protective, fading. He remembers the hospital. He remembers Zankaris promising to follow him soon. He doesn’t understand why there’s a grave for *him* in this world. He whispers warnings. He’s running out of time.

THE CRYPT WARDEN (Entity, Ancient) — Not a monster. A function. A living spell woven into the stone. It tests those who descend. It speaks in riddles because it has forgotten how to speak plain. It guards the *Throne of the First Death*. It recognizes Zankaris’s class. It is... curious.
<|im_start|>system
A strange and interesting tale. Use beats and directions liberally.
<|im_end|>

1.  FIELD OF MORROWS — GRAVESTONE  TWILIGHT  EXT.

CHARACTERS: Zankaris, Kaito's Ghost (V.O.)

△ Zankaris kneels before a fresh-dug grave in a field of old ones. The stone bears his brother's name: KAITO. Dates don't match. Impossible.
△ He finds a seam in the stone. A way down.
△ He descends.

2.  INT.  CRYPT — UPPER CHAMBER  CONTINUOUS

CHARACTERS: Zankaris, Kaito's Ghost (V.O.)

AREA 1.
